ledge as threshold between constructed and natural space

limitations: No facial expression detail confirms emotional state; phone model and screen content are invisible.

alternative_interpretations: He is waiting for someone, using the phone to coordinate timing, with the curve simply indicating the geometry of the site.
limitations: No indication of destination, companions, or prior/following movement; the curve may be purely architectural.
